research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Area 1 Security is focused on enhancing cybersecurity measures, particularly in phishing attack protection. Their R&D efforts include developing a message processing system with business email compromise detection, which computes a lookalike score to identify potential phishing attempts. Additionally, they are working on scaling stateful services hosted in clusters of server nodes, optimizing the management of server resources during scaling operations. These innovations aim to bolster the security and efficiency of cyber protection services.

overview_description.description: Based in Redwood City, CA, Area 1 Security is developing a product focused on eliminating targeted, socially engineered cyber attacks. Founded by security experts from NSA and MIT, and data analytics specialists from NSA and Disney, the mode startup has raised $25.5 million in total funding to date. Investors include Icon Ventures, Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers, Allegis Capital, Cowboy Ventures; Data Collective (DCVC); First Round Capital; RedSeal Networks CEO and former Venrock partner Ray Rothrock; and Shape Security CEO Derek Smith.
